name: ProWritingAid
tagline: A writing editor for authors, with grammar and style checks and in-depth manuscript reports.
about: ProWritingAid checks grammar and style and produces detailed reports on a manuscript. It is aimed at fiction and long-form writers.
pros: Detailed reports on style, pacing and repetition.
cons: The free version checks only a short passage at a time.
The number of reports can be overwhelming.
